description: This header file defines external API functions related to a Broker Socket TCP object within the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It contains function prototypes, license and copyright notices, and module information, but no function implementations or class definitions.

methods.name: AnscCreateBrokerSocketTcp
methods.description: Creates a new Broker Socket TCP object, given container, owner, and reserved context handles.

methods.name: AnscBktoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Broker Socket TCP object, with context and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscBktoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Broker Socket TCP object.

methods.name: AnscBktoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects for the Broker Socket TCP instance.

methods.name: AnscBktoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Broker Socket TCP object.
